criteria.title: Cleaning
criteria.description: Return copied records in original order: remove repeated record_id after its first occurrence, drop rows with missing target or load_pct outside 0–100 inclusive, then fill missing ambient_c with the median of retained non-missing ambient_c values. Preserve raw input. No other changes.

criteria.title: Summary statistics
criteria.description: Return count, mean, minimum, maximum of target and group_means by equipment_id. Retain full precision.

criteria.title: Three labelled charts
criteria.description: Return at least three actual matplotlib Figure objects: scatter load_pct vs target; bar of mean target by equipment_id in alphabetical order; target histogram with ten equal bins from minimum to maximum. Add chart titles and axis labels, including target units. A fourth figure, when required, plots record_id vs target in input order.

criteria.title: Five numerical findings
criteria.description: Return a dict with count, mean, minimum, maximum and group_gap (highest minus lowest equipment mean). Each value is a dict with value and unit; count uses observations and other values use the cohort target unit. These numerical findings are checked independently of the narrative.

criteria.title: Structured interpretation
criteria.description: Six scenario choices in DECISIONS; 5 marks for each correct choice.
